definition.description: Facing or beside a stable wall or rail on a clear level surface, establish a light support contact and rooted stance foot. Swing the free leg across the body then away to the side like a controlled pendulum only through the available comfortable frontal-plane hip range, return to the start, complete the declared repetitions, then switch sides. This excludes front/back direction, walking, kicking, marching, lunging, hopping, assessment, and running.

switch sides only after the declared repetitions

unexpectedSensations: dizziness, chest symptoms, unusual breathlessness, numbness, tingling, weakness, or loss of balance

deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: The support is stable, contact stays light, the swing stays frontal and comfortable, the stance foot and torso remain organized, and each repetition returns without a side kick or loss of balance.

deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Use a light touch, swing across and out only as far as is comfortable, return to the start, and switch sides after the planned repetitions.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate movement preparation only; no flexibility, injury-prevention, or performance outcome is guaranteed.

dizziness, chest symptoms, unusual breathlessness, disorientation, or inability to communicate

new numbness, tingling, weakness, circulation, or skin change
contraindications: symptoms, restriction, or unsafe setting conflicts with the selected task
sagittal, walking, kick, march, lunge, hop, assessment, or running intent
commonSubstitutions: Use another reviewed preparation task only after logistics, duration, balance, and downstream demands are recomputed.
Do not treat hands-free stance, front/back swings, walking swings, kicks, static stretches, marches, lunges, hopping, or assessment as automatic substitutions.
